name: Hell of a Date
source:
You’re Heraclea, and after eleven grueling labors, Queen Eurysthea has one last task for you: capture Cerberus and bring it back. You’re exhausted, but hey…how bad could a three-headed dog be?

Hades greets you warmly and guides you to the den. Somehow, this feels almost…too easy.

[From [url=https://faeflower.itch.io/hell-of-a-date]Itch.io[/url]]
